assignments.decisiveDefect: The packet tells the participant that no source it holds establishes what filing this petition costs. The compiled Arkansas profile states the Act 1460 filing fee as $0 three times, and this route is one of the Act 1460 uniform petition-and-order pairs.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.measuredDetail: participant-instructions.md line 22, under '## The filing fee', reads: 'Neither the petition nor the order states a filing fee, and no source this packet holds establishes what filing this petition costs — or whether it costs anything.' The first clause is true of the two forms. The second is false of the repository. src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/AR-arkansas.json states, at line 2506, 'Sealing petition filing fee $0 Filing fees eliminated by the 2019 amendments'; at line 2505, 'Act 1460 eliminated sealing filing fees; the real costs are records and any counsel'; and at line 2484, in the filing rule, 'File in the circuit or district court that handled the case. Act 1460 eliminated filing fees for sealing.' The same profile's form table at line 2444 lists 'Petition and Order to Seal Misdemeanor DWI / BWI Driving- or boating-while-intoxicated misdemeanor; 10-year wait' among the Act 1460 uniform pairs, so the elimination reaches this exact route.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.corroboration: The sibling family ar-arrest-seal-set, built from the same profile, states the answer at participant-instructions.md line 24: 'There is no filing fee for this petition… states it three ways'. One Arkansas route publishes the held answer and this one denies it exists.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.standard: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 A4 (a packet may never tell a participant that it does not state something it does state) and A2 (the repository includes the compiled state profile whether or not the route census enumerates it).
FEE_AND_WAIVER.whatRepairMustDo: State the $0 Act 1460 filing fee from the compiled Arkansas profile, quoting it and naming the profile. Keep the clerk-confirmation sentence but demote it to a question about that court's practice rather than the answer to the fee. Say what the waiver half means where there is no fee to waive — the sibling's paragraph on the petition's sworn 'paid all filing fees' averment is the model. Do NOT delete the sentence and leave silence; silence fails the same determination.
